command: SSH isolated-home install of the exact v1.0.3 source/wheel with the host real global-npm J.A.R.N. first on PATH and a customized schema-0 config, followed by non-billable doctor migration verification
decisions: passed: The initial fresh login and interactive shell resolved the real legacy global-npm command; after installation both resolved the new user-space jarn 1.0.3 command.
passed: The installer returned activation status 10, retained the legacy executable byte-for-byte, and displayed explicit optional-cleanup and never-delete guidance.

passed: The first non-billable doctor run transactionally migrated config version 0 to 3, created exactly one byte-identical backup, and preserved operator comments, custom headers, timeout, routing, permission, theme, and log level.
passed: Doctor returned controlled status 1 for the deliberately unreachable example provider while retaining valid schema-v1 JSON; this was not treated as a migration failure.
limitations: Historical pre-final v1.0.3 build evidence only; the final reproducible wheel is SHA-256 4216958719c4b414dc9b4804f9af66f3bbc31ee7028297126a9e00c892cb562e and must be rerun before this record can gate that candidate.
This pre-release UAT transferred the exact v1.0.3 installer source and reproducible wheel into an isolated remote /tmp fixture; the tagged public-URL canary remains a separate release gate.
First-time provider setup was disabled to isolate command collision and config migration behavior; authentication is covered by separate UAT criteria.
result: On Ubuntu 22.04/glibc 2.35, the exact v1.0.3 wheel (SHA-256 836d050cf97b375c2353f5f3e1015084c8d8f03baca363f721934f74fa098d4b) replaced PATH precedence over the retained real global-npm command, preserved that command, and migrated a customized schema-0 config to schema 3 with one byte-identical backup and valid diagnostics.
